subject: Re: Xavier Inc — Architecture demo / next steps
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@xavierinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Xavier’s search relevance pilot

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for taking the time on the discovery call last week. Based on what you shared about the search relevance pilot, I think a short technical walkthrough of our inference stack (30–40 min) would help your infra and ML teams evaluate latency/scale tradeoffs before you make a hosting decision.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 9/23, 10:00–10:40
- Thu 9/24, 14:00–14:40
- Tue 9/29, 11:00–11:40

We can tailor the demo to focus on: model latency at 2–10k qps, quantization impact, and deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated). I’ve attached a short scope doc and the RFP you sent for reference.

If none of these work, tell me a window that does and I’ll send an invite.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | (415) 555-1839

Attachments: Xavier_RFP.pdf, redwood-proposed-scope.xlsx

-----Reply (Inline)-----
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@xavierinc.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Xavier Inc Product Team <prod-team@xavierinc.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Xavier’s search relevance pilot

Hi Olga —

Really appreciate the follow-up and the proposed times. Heads up: we’ve had a change in priorities for Q4 — the execs just reallocated engineering bandwidth to a marketing personalization sprint that’s time-sensitive. That means the search/LLM pilot has been deprioritized for the rest of the year.

I don’t want to cancel the conversation entirely; we’d like to park the demo for now and revisit in the new year when roadmaps free up. Can you hold the draft scope and the notes? If useful, we’re open to a short sync in late Jan to decide next steps, but I can’t commit to dates yet.

Thanks for understanding — Avery
Avery Collins
Director, Product Engineering | Xavier Inc
avery.collins@xavierinc.com

-----Reply (Inline)-----
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@xavierinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Xavier’s search relevance pilot

Hi Avery — thanks for the update and for being transparent. Totally understand shifting priorities — I’ll mark the opportunity as paused for now and keep the materials on file.

A couple quick asks so we stay aligned:
- Would you prefer we reach out in late January or mid-February for a quick 15-min checkpoint?
- Any key stakeholders we should keep copied when we re-engage? (e.g., infra lead, data privacy)

If it helps, we can also send a 1-pager that highlights three decision criteria you shared (latency SLOs, cost per 1k qps, and on-prem vs hosted security posture) so it’s easy to pick this back up.

I’ll loop Markus on the internal side to pause pipeline actions and to note expected follow-up windows.

Best,
Olga
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

-----Internal: Markus adds guidance-----
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Xavier Inc — Architecture demo / next steps

Thanks for flagging. Quick internal note:
- Change deal stage to "Paused - Customer Prioritization" in HubSpot (deal id DEAL-8421).
- Suspend any active demo invites; do not allocate Dedicated demo seats.
- Keep the proposed scope and RFP attachments on the deal record.
- Set a reminder to reach back out on 2027-01-20 for a one-line check-in.

Olga/Marissa — please log the reason in the opportunity notes and move to internal queue "paused-prospects". We should still capture any red flags re: compliance/security that could block re-engagement later.

— Markus
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

-----External final confirmation-----
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@xavierinc.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Xavier Inc — Architecture demo / next steps

Olga —

That plan works for us. Please check back in around Jan 20th; I’ll try to surface the infra lead (Samir Patel) to the thread if they’re available then.

If anything changes on our end sooner I’ll reach out.

Appreciate the flexibility.
Avery

-----End of thread-----
